releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.0.3

Hubble 1.0.3: improve Companion setup and advanced controls

Add a bundled local Companion setup page with direct installation steps, first-page links, and backup-gated bulk appearance feedback installation. Detect same-version Companion module drift so reinstalling refreshes changed bundled content.

Harden advanced controls by preserving connection selections, validating edit sources, aligning execution timeouts, restoring legacy feedback behavior, adding action-owned feedback colors, and exposing rotary wrap controls.

Simplify the Companion guide to a plain black documentation layout and ship the synchronized 1.0.3 application and protocol versions.
